answer: In PoA, each interaction contributes to an EigenTrust-style matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest, reciprocated service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil begins as an isolated vertex with near-zero eigenvector centrality; its ember of trust cannot traverse the network or amplify through a spiral of colluding accounts, so it cannot pass consensus without independent validation over time.
